Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Artificially higher temperature entered in FMS to calculate reduced-thrust take-off setting (flex) within performance limits.

Operational example

Enter flexible assumed temperature five eight Celsius to compute flex thrust and verify take-off performance margin on runway one four.

Localized term
